shell.tagline: Drop your thoughts on the map.
shell.pitch: Pin your opinions to real places and see what people think about the spots around you.

form.signInDescription: Sign in to drop pins, comment and vote.
form.signUpDescription: Join to drop pins and share what you think about places.
form.displayNameHint: Shown on your pins and comments. You can change it later.
form.terms: By continuing you agree to our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like you@example.com.
validation.otpInvalid: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.

forgot.emailDescription: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a 6‑digit code.
forgot.otpDescription: We sent a 6‑digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
forgot.passwordDescription: Use one you don't use on other sites. You'll be signed out on your other devices.
forgot.passwordUpdatedDescription: Sign in with your new password.

errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: Password must be at most 128 characters.
errors.userAlreadyExists: An account with this email already exists.
errors.otpExpired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
errors.sessionExpired: Please sign in again to continue.
errors.userNotFound: No account found for this email.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
